title: Pig waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#F9A8C9'/>
  <!-- Body belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#FCC4DA'/>
  
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <path d='M28 34 Q22 18 34 24 Q38 28 36 36 Z' fill='#F9A8C9' stroke='#FCC4DA' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M30 32 Q27 24 33 26 Q35 28 34 33 Z' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <path d='M72 34 Q78 18 66 24 Q62 28 64 36 Z' fill='#F9A8C9' stroke='#FCC4DA' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M70 32 Q73 24 67 26 Q65 28 66 33 Z' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#F9A8C9'/>
  <!-- Head shine -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FCC4DA' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#3B1B2E'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='4.5' fill='#3B1B2E'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='34.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='34.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#C94A82'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='48' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#C94A82'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 53 Q50 58 57 53' fill='none' stroke='#C94A82' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#F27DB0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#F27DB0' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Left arm (down) -->
  <path d='M22 62 Q14 70 16 78' fill='none' stroke='#F9A8C9' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left hoof -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='79' r='5' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  
  <!-- Right arm (waving up) -->
  <path d='M78 62 Q88 54 86 40' fill='none' stroke='#F9A8C9' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Right hoof -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='38' r='5' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  
  <!-- Waving motion lines -->
  <path d='M92 30 Q95 32 93 36' fill='none' stroke='#FCC4DA' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M94 38 Q97 40 95 44' fill='none' stroke='#FCC4DA' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='9' height='10' rx='4' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='88' width='9' height='10' rx='4' fill='#F27DB0'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='37.5' cy='97' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#C94A82'/>
  <ellipse cx='62.5' cy='97' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#C94A82'/>
  
  <!-- Curly tail -->
  <path d='M80 72 Q88 68 86 62 Q84 58 90 56' fill='none' stroke='#F27DB0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
